fr_html:
Enfin le projet adopte l'idée de M. Ricci-Busatti sur les liens qui doivent exister entre la nouvelle Cour et l'ancienne Cour d'Arbitrage, ainsi que sa pensée de donner aux deux Cours un greffier commun.

Lord Phillimore ajoute que MM. Adatci et Fernandes sont avec lui-même les seuls dont les idées ne soient pas représentées dans le projet Root—Phillimore.
en_html:
Finally the project adopts the idea of M. Ricci-Busatti concerning the relations which should exist between the new Court and the old Court of Arbitration, as well as his suggestion that the two Courts should have one common registry.

Lord Phillimore added that MM. Adatci and Fernandes, and himself were the only ones whose ideas were not represented in the Root—Phillimore proposal.
